coverage.evidence_summary: Complete country-based M49 143 fabric reviewed with a source-pinned Timurid-Moghulistan segment, four capital checks, and three M49 corrections.
All 310 assignments replace provisional evidence for exactly 1444-11-11 across court, steppe, and frontier political fabrics.
Every assignment carries an evidence-backed Timurid, Chinggisid steppe, or explicitly coarse frontier grouping rather than a modern-state projection.
Date-valid records distinguish Ulugh Beg and Shah Rukh's Timurid lands from Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbeks, Moghulistan, Nogai-Manghit, and local Turkmen fabrics.
